brief:
Israeli occupation authorities issued military order 17/108/26 targeting approximately 29 dunams of land in the village of Beit Ur al-Fauqa west of Ramallah, Shehab Wire reported. The order mandates removal of wild vegetation and uprooting of olive and other trees from the affected area.

The military directive marks another instance of land appropriation in the West Bank village, where Israeli settlement expansion and resource control have accelerated in recent years.
